title: Remove dangerous channel cross terms with the actual syndrome instrument
statement: For a code separating t completed exposure locations and all-input remainders ||F_j||<=eta_j, actual syndrome measurement kills unequal syndromes. Equal syndrome at total fault degree<2t+1 forces the same corrected source character. With R_mix(sigma)=Tr_logical Phi(I_K/K tensor sigma), the complete-channel half-diamond error is at most min(1,sum_(|J|+|Q|>=2t+1) a_J a_Q), a_J=product_(j in J)eta_j; the record law is code dependent.
